**Play in your browser:** https://rdpharr.github.io/wordfront/ (nothing to install)

Or download the offline version for your computer below.

| System | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Wordfront_…_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`) |
| macOS, Apple Silicon (M1 and later) | `Wordfront_…_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Wordfront_…_x64.dmg` |
| Linux | `Wordfront_…_amd64.AppImage`, or the `.deb` / `.rpm` |

Wordfront is free, so the installers aren't code-signed, and your system will warn you once:

- **Windows:** "Windows protected your PC" → **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** open it once, then **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
  If macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Wordfront.app` in Terminal.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Wordfront_*.AppImage`, then run it.
